say: What tips are there for new joiners about leave?

body.answer:
Employee E1001, here are some current tips for new joiners about leave:
1. Your annual leave is credited only when the policy states it is not credited, so you will not receive any leave days automatically.
2. If you join after the 15th of a month, you start earning leave from the following month.
3. You may carry forward up to 15 days of unused annual leave into the next leave year, and those days do not expire on a fixed date.
4. The total annual leave balance may not exceed 45 days at any time; any leave that would push the balance above 45 days is not credited.
5. Unused annual leave above the carry‑forward limit is forfeited on 31 December.
6. When you request leave, add a note for your manager if the request is short notice; the manager usually replies within a couple of days.
7. Check the holiday calendar for your office early so you can plan trips, and ask a few weeks ahead for longer trips to ease approval.
